# mhsb-intake-leak-calculator agent instructions (canonical)

Canonical instructions live in CLAUDE.md; AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md are generated
stubs, and when any stub and this file differ, this file wins. Edit here, then
regenerate; never edit a stub outside its HARNESS-LOCAL block.

## Project
- Standalone static web tool for law firms: the owner enters intake numbers and
  sees an estimate of annual revenue recoverable across five intake stages. Zero
  backend, all computation in the browser, no analytics, no tracking, no email
  capture, no runtime network calls, self-hosted fonts.
- Live at https://www.mhsbsolutions.com/tools/intake-revenue-leak-calculator/ as
  a route on the mhsbsolutions.com site. This repository is the standalone source
  it was built from; the live route is served and promoted from the main site
  repo, not from here.
- Deploy: none from this repo. `npm run build` produces a static `dist/`. There
  is deliberately no CI or hosting config here; promoting a new version or any
  hosting or DNS change is a manual step performed elsewhere (the live route is
  served from the mhsbsolutions.com site repo).
- Off-machine sync: origin is granolacowboy/mhsb-intake-leak-calculator, but
  local `main` has a known, unreconciled divergence from it, so this repo is
  deliberately excluded from the repo-mirror auto-push allowlist. Do NOT push
  from an agent session; reconciling the divergence and any push are gated,
  user-performed steps.

## Conventions
- Stack: Astro 5 (static) + TypeScript, vanilla client-side TypeScript (no UI
  framework), plain CSS with the MHSB v4.3 brand tokens as custom properties.
  It mirrors the mhsbsolutions.com stack so it can be merged in as a route.
- The math is a hard gate. MODEL.md is the single source of truth for every
  coefficient. Each coefficient is either sourced with a dated citation or marked
  ASSUMPTION and surfaced as such in the UI. Never present an unsourced benchmark
  as fact, and never change the model without updating MODEL.md in the same commit.
- Regression guard: the five stage figures are independent single-lever gains
  that sum to the headline by construction. This is deliberately conservative and
  ignores the compounding of fixing several stages at once. Do not "improve" it
  into compounding math; that would overclaim, the failure this framing prevents.
- Verify before you call anything done: `npm run verify` (Vitest unit + build +
  Playwright e2e + brand lint), plus `npx astro check`. `npm run lint:brand` must
  stay clean.
- Out of bounds: do not add analytics, tracking, email capture, or any runtime
  network call (the zero-backend, no-tracking behavior is a product promise); do
  not add CI, hosting, or deploy config to this repo.

## Agent rules
- Update docs (README.md, MODEL.md) in the same commit as the change they describe.
- Keep changes small and verified; run `npm run verify` before reporting done.
- When a skill, brand doc, or kit conflicts with this file, this file wins; flag
  the conflict instead of obeying the stale source.
- Cross-surface: both Claude Code (terminal) and Claude Cowork (Claude Desktop)
  may open this folder and read this CLAUDE.md; carry session-to-session state in
  `state/HANDOFF.md` (handoff-core) so work resumes cleanly across surfaces.

## Brand
- Tokens and lint rules come from brand-config.json (MHSB v4.3); do not restate
  hex values or font names here.
- Voice: considered, direct, dry; no hype words. No em dashes and no en dashes
  (the brand lint enforces both).
- Keep intact everywhere it appears: the sourced-versus-ASSUMPTION labeling and
  the framing that the headline is a modeled estimate of recoverable revenue, not
  a promise, never a guaranteed ROI.
